title: Arkret Account Pairing and Agent Operation DTOs
description: Closed request and response DTOs for account pairing and Agent management operations.

agent_slug.description: Required controller-scoped Agent selector slug. Used only as the right-hand component of @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug>; not a global handle or authorization subject. Provisioning services MUST issue or update a ak.schema.agent_selector_claim.v1.

opaque_local_id.description: Deployment-local short-lived account/auth artifact id. It is an opaque_correlation value, so its lexical space is disjoint from the ak: typed-ID namespace: a value MUST NOT begin with ak:.

pairing_secret.description: One-time CSPRNG pairing secret carrying at least 128 bits of entropy. It is transmitted only in JSON bodies, never in URLs or logs.

device_pairing_code.description: Eight-character human-readable Crockford-style code carrying 40 CSPRNG bits, bound to a short-lived SAS/QR transcript and protected by a ten-failure lockout.

agent_runtime_key_possession_proof.description: Closed Ed25519 proof that the submitter controls the proposed Agent runtime key and possesses the authoritative pairing secret. Canonical transcript, equality, freshness, and final-commit re-verification rules are defined in key-management.md section 3.6.2.

audience_id.description: Stable target-service authorization identity; any verification_method remains a DID URL whose bare DID MUST project to this did_core_id.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of the 64-byte raw Ed25519 signature over the canonical transcript.

public_key.description: Canonical PublicKey DTO. Defined once in public-key.schema.json so device, agent and account surfaces share one definition.

agent_runtime_public_key.description: Closed v1 Agent runtime signing-key profile. Ed25519 is the fully-specified JOSE algorithm identifier from RFC 9864; polymorphic algorithm identifiers are rejected.

agent_status.description: Controller lifecycle intent axis. Closed enum; only the controller's pause / resume / deactivate lifecycle events change it. Pairing and key facts are reflected through the generic readiness axis and open-handle fields, never through a fourth generic state axis (key-management.md §3.6.1).

agent_runtime_state.description: Operation-local diagnostic enum used only by agent_runtime_approval_status_outcome on the unauthenticated pairing poll. It is mechanically derived from the polled handle and key facts, is never writable, and MUST NOT appear in generic Agent list/get/key_state projections: no active accepted key authorization with an unexpired bootstrap handle is pending_runtime_key; no active key with the bootstrap handle expired is pairing_expired; an active key with no unconsumed replacement handle is ready; an active key with an unexpired replacement handle is replacing.

agent_presence.description: Short-lived reachability signal only. It never substitutes for lifecycle or readiness and does not use a protocol-wide fixed five-minute refresh interval.

realm_id.description: Realm that owns the capability grant cell and therefore the required ak.capability.revoke write surface.

key_state.description: Controller-private key, pairing-handle and authorization material for a generic Agent view. This object deliberately carries no lifecycle, readiness, presence, runtime_state or backup-readiness field: the only three generic status axes are siblings on agent_projection, while pairing poll alone exposes its operation-local runtime_state diagnostic.

requested_scope.description: Controller-private projection of the required immutable global Agent key/session ceiling captured at provision time, not a grant. Content actions are the maximum actions that later key scopes, Realm-scoped grants and sessions may allow; an omitted action cannot be added later. Participation is a separate action-time deny gate and cannot add authority. Provisioning never materializes content grants from this field. Operation/service resources constrain the service surface; explicit content resource selectors only further narrow later grants. Receiver authority comes from a valid agent-requested-scope-disclosure whose digest matches the accepted-at Agent DID commitment, not this service projection.

pairing_request_id.description: Current unconsumed, unexpired pairing handle. Omit it and pairing_code/pairing_expires_at after consumption or expiry. Attach versus replace is derived from current active authorization dots, never historical rows.

pairing_expires_at.description: Authoritative pairing expiry instant in the shared byte-canonical UTC millisecond profile. The projection and ak.agent.key_pairing_request_binding.v1.expires_at use the same exact string; offset or sub-millisecond wire spellings are schema violations and MUST NOT be normalized by a verifier.

runtime_verifier_material.description: Confidential verifier-only material. Return only to the authenticated delegated Account Authority executing pair_agent_key for this exact Agent; MUST be absent from ordinary controller/runtime responses and notifications.

authorize_event.description: Fully signed ak.device.authorize initial submission authored by a current accepted device. The service MUST admit this exact Event through the ordinary Event validation/reducer path; it MUST NOT mint an Event id, rewrite the Event, or directly insert a device projection. Its typed payload is the sole source of hpke_key and the target-device possession device_signature, MUST match new_device_pubkey by device id and Ed25519 key bytes, MUST set authorization_binding_kind=accepted_device, and MUST name the approving current device id in authorized_by. The proof.verification_method bare DID component MUST project through its registered adapter to Event.actor_id.account_id.principal_id and its fragment MUST equal authorized_by; appending a fragment to did_core_id is forbidden. That Event proof, not the target device_signature, binds the exact account actor, authorized_by, not_before, expires_at and scopes, because only the approving device knows those values.

device_pairing_request_id.description: Required pairing identity bound by the single target device_signature over the full final-account challenge descriptor, including metadata digest with explicit nulls. The verifier reconstructs and compares the transcript digest. Exact replay returns the durable terminal outcome without re-reading pending state.

pairing_request_id.description: Single-use pairing artifact id returned by agent_provision_outcome. Profile-local, short-lived and not a durable protocol object ref.

requested_scope_disclosure.description: Controller-signed private disclosure addressed to the authoritative pairing verifier. The endpoint MUST consume its presentation challenge once, match agent/controller/audience, recompute the public DID commitment digest, and use the disclosed scope for the subset check. It MUST NOT copy the disclosure into authorize_event or any durable/public history.

authorize_event.description: Fully-signed ak.agent.key.authorize initial submission approved by the controller or policy engine. Its Event MUST target the Agent Principal Control Realm, carry actor_id equal to agent_id, executed_by equal to the controller DID, authorization_ref equal to the controller delegation DID URL bound by the Agent DID Document, and a proof verification method belonging to the controller or one of its currently authorized devices. The submission MUST carry ordinary publication authority evidence without rewriting the Event. Its payload.agent_key_scope MAY be narrower than, but MUST be an actions/resources/constraints subset of, the immutable provision requested_scope; every provision constraint remains mandatory. Required so key activation never depends on an unaudited pairing side effect. authorize_event.event.event_id is the pair operation idempotency identity.

agent_key_pair_request_body.description: One controller approval command bound to the frozen candidate and handle. The signed authorization Event supplies Agent, key, method, scope, expiry and exact supersedes. Verifiers load possession proof and candidate from the authoritative confidential record, never caller echoes. Accepted Seal processing automatically advances the durable command; exact retries only observe or recover it.

activation_state.description: Durable command state. awaiting_accepted_frontier waits for the exact authorization Event covering Seal; accepted Seal processing activates automatically without another pair command. active preserves lifecycle intent and does not itself issue a session. cancelled is terminal after handle invalidation, expiry, changed authority or failed activation fence. Replays never revive a cancelled command.

agent_runtime_approval_request_body.description: Runtime-to-controller pending approval request for Agent-agent key pairing. The runtime proves possession of the local key and the short pairing code; the controller still must approve by signing ak.agent.key.authorize and submitting agent_key_pair_request_body. The service computes ak.agent.runtime_key_binding.v1 from agent_id, pairing_request_id, verification_method, public-key digest and attestation digest. One open pairing_request_id has at most one pending stable binding: same-binding retry is idempotent and refreshes the full request while retaining approval/notification ids; a different binding fails with HTTP 409 agent_runtime_request_conflict without replacement.

pairing_request_id.description: Single-use pairing artifact id returned by agent_provision_outcome. Profile-local, short-lived and not a durable protocol object ref.

agent_runtime_approval_controller_projec.description: Authenticated minimal frozen candidate projection. Raw key/method and optional attestation are public approval inputs; approval_request_id and stable digest do not change when a fresh PoP is accepted for the same candidate. Full possession proof and pairing secret are not included. Controller must inspect exact Agent, key fingerprint, scope/expiry and supersedes in the Event before signing.

proof_verified_at.description: Authoritative Station timestamp at which this exact PoP passed freshness and signature checks. Same-candidate refresh updates this time and PoP atomically; it is not an independent proof against the Station.

agent_runtime_verifier_material.description: Authenticated confidential S2S verifier record for the exact current handle/candidate. Together with sibling authoritative pairing code, expiry and service identity, this provides all raw inputs for independent PoP transcript reconstruction/signature verification. A verified boolean is not a substitute. Freeze the candidate; freshness proof may refresh without invalidating approval.

agent_human_approval_error_details.description: Closed RFC 9457 extension set returned by ak.gate.account.command.issue_session_grant.v1 when an agent_key_proof request needs out-of-band controller approval. The enclosing Problem type MUST be https://arkret.org/problems/claim_required. The agent runtime MUST NOT be given CAPTCHA, OTP, browser-login, or other interactive human challenge material.

agent_runtime_approval_status_request_bo.description: Runtime-side poll for the controller decision on a previously submitted runtime key request. The pairing_request_id, pairing_code, and agent_id triple is the query credential and MUST be sent in the JSON body, never in URL path or query string. A record miss and a pairing_code or agent_id mismatch MUST be indistinguishable (both not_found). HTTP responses MUST carry Retry-After; clients wait at least that interval and stop polling after pairing expiry.

pairing_request_id.description: Single-use pairing artifact id returned by agent_provision_outcome. Profile-local, short-lived and not a durable protocol object ref.

agent_runtime_approval_status_outcome.description: Operation-local status for the exact handle/candidate. Authorization fields are present only after durable Seal activation and must be checked against the runtime own method/raw-key digest; then a fresh agent_key_proof is required for session issue. Fields occur together. Expired, unknown or invalidated handles use uniform anti-enumeration behavior. Status never authorizes a key by itself.

authorized_public_key_digest.description: SHA-256 of the decoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key using the unique agent_signing_public_key_digest helper; the runtime compares it to its own key.

agent_provision_request_body.description: Controller-authored Agent bootstrap. Before prepare, the controller publishes a signed, PCR-independent did:webvh inception whose document contains the managed-controller delegation but no ArkretPrincipalControlRealm service. prepare receives that did, verifies the accepted inception and returns its exact initial_resolution plus an opaque allocation. The controller freezes the Agent PCR genesis with that commitment, derives principal_control_realm_id, and commits one ak.agent.provision Event. After PCR acceptance, the controller publishes the pre-rotation-authorized DID update containing the create-locked Realm binding. The service exposes the Agent and pairing handle only after that update is accepted.

did.description: Controller-authored Agent did:webvh whose accepted inception is independent of the future PCR Realm id.

principal_control_realm_id.description: Agent PCR realm id the controller derived as retype(event_id) of the Agent PCR ak.realm.create envelope it froze locally, and signed into provision_event. A service MUST NOT choose it; commit MUST reject any value that differs from the provision payload byte for byte. It is distinct from the controller PCR that carries provision_event. This transport field is not inside any digest preimage; the ordering the controller MUST follow is key-management.md 3.6.3 and the named encoding.md 6.0.1 exemption on the payload field.

requested_scope.description: Required immutable global Agent key/session ceiling, not a grant. Later key scopes, Realm grants and session requests MUST NOT exceed its actions, resource selectors or mandatory constraints. Participation is an independent action-time deny gate and cannot restore authority omitted here. Provisioning never materializes content grants from this field. Operation/service resources constrain the service surface; explicit content resource selectors only further narrow later grants.

controller_station_id.description: Authenticated controller account Station. Together with the session principal_id this selects the controller authority; PCR identifiers are not exposed.

agent_provision_outcome.description: Four-stage outcome. prepare returns awaiting_controller_event with an accepted inception commitment. An accepted ak.agent.provision moves it to awaiting_pcr_genesis. PCR acceptance moves it to awaiting_did_binding until the controller-authored continuous WebVH update publishes the exact Realm service entry. The Agent, pairing handle and list/get projection become visible only at complete.

did.description: Complete Agent DID whose registered adapter projection is agent_id; Agent PCR genesis initial_resolution MUST commit this value and its verified method head.

initial_resolution.description: Exact verified accepted inception position. It is immutable across all provisioning outcomes and is copied byte-for-byte into Agent PCR genesis.

principal_control_realm_id.description: Agent PCR realm id the controller derived locally as retype(event_id) of the Agent PCR genesis it froze, and declared in the provision payload. Until that genesis is accepted this is a claim, not a live Realm.

controller_realm_id.description: Authenticated controller PCR in which the provision Event must be authored. Present only while status is awaiting_controller_event.

allocation_handle.description: Service-signed opaque allocation binding returned only by prepare and presented unchanged by commit.

requested_scope_digest.description: Digest of the complete immutable requested_scope commitment in the Agent DID accepted create-locked bootstrap history (entry 1); only this digest, not the complete scope, is public. The client MUST recompute it from its submitted scope, returned agent_id and authenticated controller DID.

agent_renew_pairing_request_body.description: Re-open bootstrap pairing or replace an agent runtime. The service issues a fresh one-time pairing_request_id + pairing_code; every previously issued pairing handle for the agent becomes permanently unresolvable. An Agent with no active accepted runtime-key authorization re-opens bootstrap pairing; an Agent holding an active authorized key (lifecycle active or paused) performs runtime replacement re-pairing with a different raw Ed25519 signing key. Reusing the replaced key is rejected; same-key reauthorization is not pairing. Lifecycle intent, existing keys and grants stay untouched until the new controller-signed authorization with an exact supersedes set is accepted atomically, and completion preserves lifecycle intent. deactivated rejects.

agent_renew_pairing_outcome.description: Fresh single-use pairing handle and CSPRNG secret with at least 128 bits of entropy. Attach or replacement is derived at approval from the complete current authorization set. Renew does not change principal, slug, lifecycle, keys, grants or history and never gates on sibling slug availability.

requested_scope_digest.description: Unchanged digest of the immutable requested_scope commitment in the Agent DID binding; the complete scope remains controller-private.

agent_pairing_bootstrap.description: One-time bootstrap material handed to an Agent runtime after provisioning. New resolver responses MUST include runtime_identity; its omission is only for reading older stored bootstrap material. This is not a session grant, capability grant or long-term secret.

agent_pairing_runtime_identity.description: Identity context obtained from the accepted Agent/controller binding. It does not authorize the runtime key. The verification method controller MUST project to bootstrap.agent_id; its fragment is a key label, not a human device identity.

agent_pairing_resolve_request_body.description: Body-only resolver input for short agent pairing handoff links. The token is obtained from a URL fragment or equivalent out-of-band channel and MUST NOT be sent in URL path or query.

lifecycle_event.description: Closed ak.self.agent.pause Event authored in the Agent PCR and executed/signed by the authenticated controller delegation. The service submits these exact bytes through ordinary Event admission and never synthesizes an Agent-authored Event. Its optional payload.reason MUST equal the request reason exactly (both absent or the same string).

Closed ak.self.agent.resume Event authored in the Agent PCR and executed/signed by the authenticated controller delegation. Sidecar desired membership is re-derived from accepted lifecycle and exact Realm membership after admission; the request carries no writable Sidecar roster or acknowledgement.

The single controller-authorized terminal ak.self.agent.deactivate Event. Once accepted, lifecycle is an unavoidable AND gate that makes every subordinate runtime key, session, pairing handle, capability grant, KeyPackage, presence and future submission ineffective. Cleanup Events are not part of this request. Optional payload.reason MUST equal request reason.

provisioning_phase.description: Closed reconciliation phase. Clients derive localized explanatory text from this phase; no parallel reason string is carried.

control_frontier.description: UTF-8 byte-lexicographically sorted accepted refs for Sidecar genesis, ownership, Agent lifecycle/runtime-key authorization, and exact Realm membership. It excludes action grants, participation selections, and MLS/key-readiness results.

current_controller_device_ready.description: True only when the authenticated controller session device is the accepted genesis creator device or has completed matching Welcome and KeyPackage consume evidence.

desired_agent_ids.description: Read-only projection derived at the accepted frontier: active, runtime-key-authorized Agent principals owned by the Sidecar controller and also active members of sidecar.realm_id. It is not caller-authored or reducer-stored and cannot be edited through Sidecar operations.

effective_agent_ids.description: Desired Agent principals that are members of the current accepted Sidecar MLS epoch and have completed target-device Welcome/KeyPackage consumption and key readiness. Reducer/service MUST enforce this set is a subset of desired_agent_ids. The controller is represented by sidecar.controller_account_id and is not duplicated in either Agent array.

version.description: Account Authority CAS version for this exact agent/scope selection.

expected_version.description: Value to echo verbatim into the next participation replace for this exact agent/scope selection.

next_replace_input.description: Verbatim prepare input for the next ak.self.agent.participation.resource.replace.v1 of this entry; member names match the replace request byte-for-byte per the service-http-binding.md 2.2.2 echo-container discipline. A first-ever selection has no entry row and uses expected_version 0.
